# Independent audit: actual critical triangle roof parity obstruction

Source: `candidate f3ba948da6193c55`.

**Result: full Sections 1–5 PASS.** No correction requested. The matching
checker was independently rerun: **344 exact checks PASS**.

I checked the mathematical argument independently as follows.

1. Both affine-radius regions have integral vertices, so their exact
   Minkowski interpolation proves canonicality on every real base.
   Positivity follows from \(|2z_1+z_2|\le6\); all 25 integer bases are
   retained. The sampled radius and squared-radius sums are consistent.

2. At the proposed source, pair (z,-z\) and use the actual triangle
   two-sided tail inequality. The central fiber is present and positive,
   so equality first requires one of the three ordinary canonical
   directions. In those directions every nonzero threshold pair has
   strictly larger tail sum; hence all base tilts vanish. Pure-base caps
   have more than half the total mass because the positive central fiber
   lies on every such through-origin boundary. This checks all normals,
   not only the three displayed caps.

3. The three displayed caps cover every ambient point. For (x\ne0\),
   one canonical form is strictly positive and its parallel cap loses
   positive mixed volume. For (x=0,p\ne0\), expansion of the actual
   isolated-vertex formula has negative linear coefficient
   \(-4|T|109|p|^2/9\). The quadratic remainder is finite and every
   status remains proper for sufficiently small positive tilt. These
   facts prove uniqueness among every actual mixed source.

4. The raw coareas are all (2r_z\), including the nonunit third normal;
   this gives equal response weights. The section centroid cancels both
   continuously (centered segments) and in the base (paired coareas).
   On an edge, the two nonincident cap indicators give the stated
   one/two/one pattern. Multiplying by (1/\gamma\) gives densities
   (3/4,3/2,3/4\). The middle row probabilities have mean zero
   displacement, and their two shifted densities are each (1/4\),
   so the target is exactly uniform. This proves one common actual
   normal-preserving martingale for every normal-dependent convex test.
   No support allocation convention is needed because all cuts are
   proper.

5. A support plane for (7-|q|\) cannot have contact points on both
   strict sides of its genuine crease. The four negative-side witnesses
   realize all four parities, and their negatives give the same parity
   list on the positive side. Each parity therefore occurs in at least
   two different cover cells, so the total count is at least eight.
   The two actual face minors attain eight and are closed. No disjointness
   assumption about the proposed cover is used.

The limitations are correctly stated. The depth is (4/9\), while the
relevant target here is (1/9\). Neither a joint body minimum nor strict
minor quotas is claimed. This is an actual cap-realized obstruction to
the proposed support-face parity partition, not an OC obstruction.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
